newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein easier, interest thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein easier, interest thin.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally easier in late trading on Monday as demand remained weak, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,420-25 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, against 1,425 rupiah at the opening, but quotes were also heard at 1,410-15 rupiah.
Crude palm oil was done at an equivalent of 1,223 rupiah/kg at a 500-tonne tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan, unchanged from the previous tender price.
"Crude palm oil is showing no signs of weakening," one trader said. "Olein needs to adjust higher."
Traders said that if the margin between crude palm oil and olein does not improve, it might not be profitable enough to process the raw material into olein.
One said players might resort to stepping up exports of crude palm oil.

Data from Belawan Port showed that the MV Santorini will leave the port for Singapore today with 4,500 tonnes of palm kernel expeller. The MT Tirta Kirana left on Sunday for Tanjung Priok in Jakarta with 2,000 tonnes of olein.
